author: pablocz
body:
(Racism Againts the Mexican Population.)

Me presento hoy como Mexicano y poniendo frente a gente como tal que nos viene a poner una imagen racista la cual no nos hace ver bien como país, Y nos degrada y presionan a nuestra nación con un acto racista al igual que Degradando la Bandera de mi Nación.

El simple hecho de que el como persona me diga frijolero, no me molestó lo que enverdad me ofendió fue el hecho en el que el allá Utilizado la bandera de mi País como una imagen racista. 

Por eso les exhorto a que el sea sancionado permanentemente si es que es posible, esto no es solo una falta de respeto, ya van varias veces, no estoy 100% seguro. Pero me informaron que "TheMexicanBean" es una de sus alt-accounts. 

Espero me entiendan y respondan con un fuerte castigo, el cual el necesita.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Today I present Myself as a Mexican, I'm Making this report because of a racist image, in which promotes a false image as a country, It Insults a Population and degrades our nation with a racist act, aswell as making use of our Flag as a Image.

The simple word "Beaner" did not offend me, What really did was the fact that he used my Mexican Flag as a racist joke.

That's why I came here to inform you that he has to get punished permanently if it's possible. This is not a disrespect, there have been multiple times, I'm not 100% sure. But i've been informed that "TheMexicanBean" is one of his alt-accounts.

I wish you guys understand and respond with a big punishment, which he needs. 


Just a heads up guys, the term "Beaner" is racist. If you don't know, In the early 1850's The U.S. army invaded México. Fighting for the northen part or México, ( California, Arizona, Nevada, Colorado, Utah ) México in that time was poor in the nothern regions, they could only eat beans, That's all they could affort. Which relate to the comment "Beaner" insulting us. And just FYI that's when the term "Gringos" was born. The Mexican Population ment "Green Go!" (U.S. Army's uniform was Green, in which the native mexicans wanted them to leave they're lands.)
